goal: Implement Slice S3 of Initiative explicit-phase-entry per docs/specs/explicit-phase-entry.spec.md (T3): the Pi extension records literal phase entries from non-extension input and refuses imm_canary_enrollment and start_unattended_batch before the authority dialog in a session without a live imm-run entry, with the same reason code and recovery action as Claude Code. Characterize the real Pi input payload of a slash entry first (assumption A2). User scenario SCN-5 (manual) belongs to this Slice.

acceptance.assertion: Per T3 and invariants I1, I2, I3 of docs/specs/explicit-phase-entry.spec.md (source: user decision U2; repository evidence .pi-extension/imm-canary-work.ts input handler): on Pi, imm_canary_enrollment and start_unattended_batch reach the authority dialog port only after a literal non-extension imm-run entry in that session; with no entry, an entry carried by extension-sourced input, or a run entry revoked by a later plan entry, the tool returns run_entry_required before the dialog port is called. Seam: new tests/pi-phase-entry-gate.test.ts driving the registered input handler and each tool's execute.

Per T2, T3 of docs/specs/explicit-phase-entry.spec.md (source: delegated technical choice, one refusal contract for both Hosts): Claude Code and Pi return the identical run_entry_required reason code and the identical single recovery action for a refused Enrollment and a refused batch start, and the existing Pi tool tests pass with a recorded run entry where they exercise those tools. Seam: tests/dual-host-assurance-conformance.test.ts equality assertion plus the existing Pi Enrollment and batch authority tests.
